ns2:section.sectionText: This course focuses on branding Italian food. Its purpose is to advance students' understanding of one of the world's most successful ethnic food branding cases within the context of the globalization of food markets. Throughout the course students will study branding and advertising strategies, food culture, markets and media in the US and Italy to learn the key principles in food marketing in the two continents. Students will travel to Rome for the field study portion from 5/15/13-5/30/13. The field study portion will be 1 credit hour, and both portions of the course are required in order to earn the 3 combined credits. Registration requires permission of instructor.
